The SS8050DBU is an NPN Bipolar Junction Transistor (BJT) manufactured by onsemi (formerly Fairchild Semiconductor).

Key Specifications

• Transistor Type: NPN
• Package / Case: TO-92-3 (Bulk packaging, suffix DBU)
• Maximum Collector Current (\(I_{C}\)): 1.5 A
• Collector-Emitter Breakdown Voltage (\(V_{CEO}\)): 25 V
• Collector-Base Voltage (\(V_{CBO}\)): 40 V
• Emitter-Base Voltage (\(V_{EBO}\)): 6 V
• Power Dissipation (\(P_{D}\)): 1 W
• Transition Frequency (\(f_{T}\)): 100 MHz
• \(h_{FE}\) Classification: Grade 'D' (DC current gain ranging from 160 to 300)
• Lifecycle Status: End-of-Life / Obsolete (scheduled for discontinuation by the manufacturer).

Common Applications

• General-purpose switching circuits
• Low-power audio and class-B amplifiers
• Driver stages for relays, lamps, and solenoids
• Complementary pair use with the SS8550 (PNP)
